headline: Federal Reserve Holds US Interest Rate at 3.75%-4.00% as S&P 500 Rises
summary: The Federal Reserve kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 3.75% to 4%, with two policymakers voting for a hike. The S&P 500 gained 0.3% following the decision.
why: The Federal Reserve's monetary policy decisions set global borrowing costs and influence capital flows across worldwide financial markets.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: U.S. equities edged higher following the Federal Reserve's decision to maintain benchmark interest rates.

why_moved: The Federal Reserve kept interest rates steady at 3.75%-4%, supporting modest equity market gains despite two dissents for an increase.
